AI powered charging enables Geely’s fastest production-ready charging performance to date.
In real-world tests, saw Lynk & Co 10 and Zeekr 001 charge 10% to 70% in 4 minutes 30 seconds, and 10% to 97% in 8 minutes 40 seconds.
AI thermal management maintains average battery temperature of 55°C and limit peak temperature to under 65°C during fast charging.
Industry’s first five-point liquid cooling system eliminates bottlenecks by managing heat throughout entire charging chain.
Lithium-ion pulse restoration technology uses micro-pulse currents to reverse damage from fast charging, adding up to 20% more battery cycle life.
Next-gen Ultra Short Blade Battery cut heat during charging by 10% while increasing peak charging rate to 6C for affordable models.
